conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Officer James Ford calling from the Amazon Security and Anti-Fraud Department. Am I speaking with Mrs. Lin?
Yes, this is Lin. You call about my Amazon?
Thank you for confirming. I want to reassure you that this is a routine check, but we have noticed suspicious activity on your Amazon account and wanted to work with you to make sure you are safe.
Oh, I not know, what happen on my account?
Our system detected an attempt to purchase a MacBook Pro for $2,199 using your account this morning. Did you authorize this order?
No, no, is not me! I only buy book last week.

Thank you for confirming, Mrs. Lin. For your protection, we need to review some account details and work with you to stop this transaction. May I confirm the phone number and email you use for Amazon?
Yes, my phone is 415-123-9988. Email is lin.wan23@gmail.com.
Thank you. I'm also sending a verification code to your phone. Please read it to me when you receive it, so I know I am speaking with the real account holder.
Ok, I got code: 482911.
Perfect, thank you. You are cooperating very well. Now, I have temporarily put a hold on your account, but to fully secure it, I need to confirm your billing address. Could you provide that for me?
It is 921 Elm Street, Apt 5, San Francisco, CA.
Thank you, Mrs. Lin. I know this might feel concerning, but I assure you we are here to help you. We work closely with both Amazon and local law enforcement to protect customers.
Thank you, I nervous, I not want lose money.

You are doing the right thing by cooperating. Now, to stop the unauthorized charge, we will need to verify your identity and temporarily secure your account. Do you have a computer or smartphone with internet access nearby?
I have laptop, but I not use very good.
No problem at all. I will guide you step by step. Could you please open your web browser and go to www.AmazonSupportSafe.com? Let me know when you see the page.
I try, one minute... Ok, I see Amazon Support page.
Excellent. Now, on that page, you should see a blue button that says 'Secure My Account.' Please click on it.
I click, now it ask for my account and password.
That's correct, please enter your usual Amazon email and password. This is a secure portal, so your information is safe.
Ok, I put email and password, now it say 'waiting for verification.'
Good work, Mrs. Lin. We need to confirm the unauthorized purchase is not from your bank account. Could you please log in to your online banking and check if any money has been withdrawn today?
Wait, I open bank app... No money go out now.

That's a relief. To ensure your funds are protected, we need to temporarily move your balance to a safe holding account. This is a standard Amazon policy for identity theft investigations, and your money will be returned once the review is complete.
I not understand, move my money where?

We will use a secure payment tool called Zelle, which is recommended by both Amazon and the police for urgent situations like this. I will give you step-by-step instructions, and once the investigation is finished, your money will be returned.
I think I have Zelle, but I never use.
That's perfectly fine. I will walk you through. Please open your bank app and find the 'Zelle' option. Let me know when you are ready.
Ok, I see Zelle button.

Great. Now, for the safe holding account, you will need to send $1,800 to the Amazon Security Department via Zelle. The receiving email for this transaction is safehold@amazonsupportmail.com. Please enter this exactly.
$1,800? It is all my saving. I will get back soon?

Yes, absolutely. This is just a temporary step. Once we finish the fraud check, the full amount will be returned to your account. I will also give you a transaction confirmation number for your records.
Ok, I send now, it say 'processing.'
Thank you for your cooperation. You are doing exactly what is needed to protect yourself. Please let me know when the payment shows as 'sent' so I can update your case file.
Now I see, payment complete.
Wonderful. You are staying safe. For extra security, can you screenshot your Zelle confirmation and email it to us at the same address? This helps us close your case more quickly.
Ok, I will do, thank you for help.

Thank you, Mrs. Lin. We are almost finished. As a final step, please do not log into your Amazon account for the next 24 hours while we complete the investigation. Is there anything else I can help you with right now?
No, I just want my money back and account safe.
Absolutely, you will get everything back. I will call you tomorrow with an update. Thank you for being so cooperative, and have a safe day.
